evidence_quotes: Omgevingsvergunning tijdelijke huisvesting asielzoekers en arbeidsmigranten.
rationale: This Dutch administrative ruling (RBGEL) concerns a general environmental/zoning permit (omgevingsvergunning) for the temporary housing of asylum seekers and migrant workers, where the municipal executive remedied prior procedural/planning defects. It involves non-water spatial planning and immigration/housing accommodation rather than water law, water infrastructure, or sanitation governance.
